summary: Backend testing completed for 3 Job OS fixes (iteration 49). All 25 new tests + 24 regression tests passed (49 total). Verified: (1) dc_created SC excluded from consolidation, (2) JW GRN endpoint works for Job OS, (3) GRN page filter logic for pending JW orders, (4) No PO for Job OS SCs with job_work_parts.
seed_data_creation: Test data created dynamically with TEST_ prefix for items, suppliers, routings, BOMs, production orders, work orders, SC orders, and DCs
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 Job OS fixes verified working correctly: (1) Consolidation exclusion: After DC sent (dc_created=true), outsourcing to same supplier creates NEW SC instead of consolidating. Query uses $or: [{dc_created: {$exists: false}}, {dc_created: false}]. (2) JW GRN: POST /api/job-work/receive-grn works for Job OS SCs - adds FG stock, updates received_quantity, completes SC. (3) GRN page filter: Frontend filters JW orders with status=in_progress AND (SC with RM: lines.sent_quantity > 0 OR Job OS: dc_created=true). (4) No PO for Job OS: Frontend shows Create PO button only for without_material SCs WITHOUT job_work_parts (old flow). Job OS SCs with job_work_parts show 'Receive via GRN' instead.

fix_1_dc_created_excludes_consolidation.details: Created SC with items A+B, sent DC (dc_created=true), then outsourced item C to SAME supplier. Result: NEW SC created for item C (not consolidated into first SC). Consolidation query correctly excludes dc_created=true SCs.

fix_2_jw_grn_for_job_os.details: POST /api/job-work/receive-grn works for Job OS SCs. Tested: created Job OS SC, sent DC, received GRN. FG stock increased by received quantity, SC status changed to completed.

fix_3_grn_page_shows_both_types.details: Frontend filter logic verified via API: pendingJW = orders where status=in_progress AND job_work_parts.length > 0 AND ((subcontract_type != without_material AND lines.sent_quantity > 0) OR (subcontract_type == without_material AND dc_created))

fix_4_no_po_for_job_os.details: Frontend shows Create PO button only for without_material SCs WITHOUT job_work_parts. Job OS SCs (without_material WITH job_work_parts) show 'Receive via GRN' label instead.

regression_consolidation.details: Consolidation still works for SCs without dc_created. Outsourcing ops on different MOs to same supplier consolidates into single SC with multiple items in job_work_parts.

regression_sc_with_rm.details: SC with RM flow unchanged. Stock deducted correctly when skip_stock_deduct is not set.
